decisive_items: intermittent fever with chills and profuse sweating
no travel history to leishmaniasis‐endemic areas
response.rationale: R3 best fits the classic malaria pattern of intermittent fever with chills and profuse sweating plus massive splenomegaly, with no raw contradiction. R5 has overlapping fever, splenomegaly, and cytopenias but is explicitly contradicted by the absence of travel to leishmaniasis-endemic areas. R1 and R2 lack fever and cytopenic support, while R4 has no raw support and a normal chest radiograph.

rejected.why: Only splenomegaly and hepatomegaly are supported; no fever or cytopenic raw support, and no lymphadenopathy argues against lymphoma.
Only massive splenomegaly is supported; no autoimmune or lymphoproliferative features and no lymphadenopathy.
No raw support spans; normal chest radiograph and lack of TB-specific findings make tuberculosis unlikely.
